name: Exploring product-truth flows in the Atlas
summary: The user journey through the Atlas /flows view: open the view to see every flow listed, filter by source (mock vs real) and kind (user/data/architecture), select a flow to render its graph, open a step to inspect its acceptance criteria's live status plus the mock records and mockup it uses, and cross-jump from an acceptance criterion back to the flows it appears in. This is how a person sees product truth visually rather than reading JSON.

steps.label: Open the Flows view
steps.human: The person opens the Atlas /flows view and sees every product-truth flow listed, with the selected one rendered as a graph.

steps.label: Choose source (mock/real) and kind (user/data/architecture)
steps.human: The person uses the source toggle to filter flows by mock vs real.

steps.label: Select a flow to render its graph
steps.human: The person uses the kind chooser to filter flows by user/data/architecture and selects one to render its graph.

steps.label: Open a step to see its ACs' live status + mock records + mockup
steps.human: The person opens a step in the drawer and sees its acceptance criteria's live work_status, the mock records the step uses, and its mockup.

steps.label: Jump from an AC to the flows it appears in
steps.human: From an acceptance-criterion node the person jumps to the flows that criterion appears in.

acceptance_scenarios.when: the person opens the Atlas /flows view
acceptance_scenarios.then: every flow is listed and the selected one renders as a graph

acceptance_scenarios.given: flows of both mock and real source
acceptance_scenarios.when: the person toggles the source filter
acceptance_scenarios.then: the flow list is filtered by mock vs real

acceptance_scenarios.when: the person chooses a kind and selects a flow
acceptance_scenarios.then: the list is filtered by user/data/architecture and the chosen flow renders
the step drawer shows its ACs' live status, the mock records it uses, and its mockup

acceptance_scenarios.given: an acceptance-criterion node in the graph
acceptance_scenarios.then: they are taken to the flows that criterion appears in

provenance.note: Real user-flow describing the Atlas /flows explorer that was just built.
